verbatim_quote.english_translation: or an even harder test, to filter out the wrong proxies.

extracted_decision.summary: Accept the lightweight HTTP-204 status check instead of a body-download test, to avoid overloading the box across ~7330 nodes every 60s.
extracted_decision.rationale: A body-download health test across thousands of nodes per minute would overload the machine.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: A 204 check may not catch nodes that answer but serve broken content.
